So me and a couple of old buddies were at a fast-casual restaurant for dinner and a fat guy was seated at the next table with his equally corpulent wife (presumably). Fat wife was oblivious to the crowd and was happily devouring her heapful of food (pasta, wings, etc), while fat guy was solemnly eating his salad as his eyes darted from table to table. We made eye contact as I sank my fangs on a big, juicy piece of steak and his expression was priceless-- like a sad puppy getting denied a treat by his master. I almost felt bad for him but I reminded myself that I will be a disappointment to my fellow shitlords here at FPH, so I didn't. But I made sure to show him throughout the meal that I was really enjoying my protein-filled dinner-- and I need not worry about calorie-counting shit and stuff.

Later on I was trying to think of possible reasons why that fattie at the restaurant who was a good 150lbs larger than me, was eating an awful plate of salad instead of the usual obeast comfort foods. I can't imagine what it feels like for a fattie to not be eating high-carb and high-fat meal and eating a salad instead (because even I don't like fresh salads that much and I prefer steamed or lightly stir-fried veggies). Could be that he is just starting on a diet, or that he got a scary prognosis from his doc. If he is really trying to reduce his weight, then good for him, but I could also think of a couple of reasons why he'll most probably fail instead of succeeding:

  1. He doesn't seem to get the support from his wife (who was munching like crazy and oblivious to his hubby's plight)
  2. He is eating at a restaurant instead of eating at home. (I think that if you're on a diet and you eat in places where other people eat the things YOU CAN'T eat, you'll just feel depressed)
  3. He is not eating the right diet food-- he should have ordered the steak or some other heavy-protein meal. Because I bet my skinny ass that he'll go hungry again an hour after eating that salad.

Thanks for reading! I see a lot of fatties everywhere but this is the first time in a while that I've seen a fattie eat a salad. Usually they avoid them (Hence, salad dodger). hehehe.
